description: The dispatcher routes `create <description>` to the create-prd skill and passes the rest of the arguments through unchanged: a non-interactive run saves one PRD under docs/PRD/ about the described product (csv2json), with REQ-NNN headings, Given/When/Then acceptance criteria and `Constitution compliance: passed`, the routing keyword `create` is not carried into the PRD's title or label, and no implementation files are written. Limits: only the `create` route is exercised (not `refine`, and not the no-keyword halt that prints the keyword table), and the checks read the saved PRD, not the transcript, so they cannot tell that the sibling skill was read rather than re-implemented. The baseline arm (no plugin, plain prompt) is expected to measure the plugin's conventions (PRD ids, REQ/AC structure, constitution line), not the router. The fixture carries a minimal docs/standards/constitution.md because the Constitution Gate halts without one.
prompt:
create csv2json: a small command-line tool that converts a CSV file into a JSON array of objects, for data analysts who currently do this by hand. --foreman

This is a non-interactive run: ask no questions, choose the recommended option for anything unclear, and save the PRD under docs/PRD/. Write only the PRD. Do not implement anything.
